description: The Java Agent SDK (sdk/java) makes no REST call to core: its only HTTP clients (agent-core WebhookHook and approval JdkHttpTransport) post to URLs the host application configures (a policy webhook, a Slack or Teams incoming webhook). What it shares with core is the audit record shape: io.vegaduta.agent.api.audit.AuditEvent declares that its first eight fields match core's published audit contract (contracts/outbound/audit-event.schema.json), which is the element shape of GET /api/audit-log (core/audit AuditLogController -> AuditLogEntryResponse). A tool that reads audit from both an SDK-governed app and core relies on these fields keeping their names. The interaction below is therefore a shape-alignment contract, not a call the SDK makes; the consumer test is sdk/java/agent-testkit/src/test/java/io/vegaduta/agent/testkit/contract/CoreConsumerContractTest.java.
